answer: The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in marble, expire in basalt, and prism lists each expiry. Someone running 164 aliases hence needs 63 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3976 identities would post 3735 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
